Definition: from G2596 and G2806; to break down, i.e. divide:--break.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus took the loaves, looked up to heaven, blessed, and broke them, and the disciples set the broken bread before the crowd.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the breaking is where the multiplying happens, because He feeds thousands with what is broken in His hands.
RelatedEvents: The Feeding of the Five Thousand
